```ts
function seed(): void {
  resetWorld();
  followUps.length = 0;
  commitFails = false;
  DB.user = [
    baseUser({ id: NOA, name: 'Noa', language: 'he', location: '' }),
    baseUser({ id: TAL, name: 'Tal', telegramId: BigInt(TAL_TG) }),
  ];
}
const userRow = (id: number): Row => DB.user.find(u => u.id === id) as Row;
const pendingKeys = (): string[] => [...redisStore.keys()].filter(k => k.startsWith('oauth:pending:'));

async function main() {
  await installSigninWorld();
  stubModule('src/services/reminder-cache.ts', {
    syncReminderCacheEntry: async (user: Row) => {
      if (commitFails) throw new Error('the reminder cache refused (smoke)');
      followUps.push(`reminder-cache:${user.id}`);
    },
    removeUserFromCache: async () => undefined,
    getEarlyAdoptionMode: async () => false,
    getGlobalRemindersEnabled: async () => true,
  });
  stubModule('src/services/setup-tracks.ts', {
    clearGoogleTracks: async (id: number) => void followUps.push(`setup-tracks:${id}`),
    setupTrackKeys: () => [],
  });
  stubModule('src/services/calendar-read/google.ts', { stampGoogleCache: async (id: number) => void followUps.push(`stamp:${id}`) });
  stubModule('src/services/google-sync/links.ts', {
    enableSyncLink: async (id: number, sync: Row) => {
      followUps.push(`enable-sync:${id}:${sync.nativeCalendarId}`);
      return { status: 'created', linkId: 'link-1' };
    },
    restoreSyncLinks: async (id: number) => void followUps.push(`restore-sync:${id}`),
    syncCopyFilter: async () => null,
    syncCopyCalendarIds: async () => [],
  });
  stubModule('src/services/analytics-service.ts', {
    addBreadcrumb: () => undefined,
    setUserContext: () => undefined,
    trackActivityAsync: (id: number, action: string) => void followUps.push(`activity:${id}:${action}`),
    trackActivity: async () => undefined,
    ACTIVITY_RETENTION_DAYS: 90,
    ACTIVITY_PURGE_BATCH: 5000,
    purgeOldActivity: async () => 0,
  });
  const route = await load('app/api/oauth/claim/route.ts');
  const connect = await load('src/services/google-connect.ts');
  const { decrypt } = await load('src/utils/encryption.ts');
  const { REDIS_KEYS } = await load('src/config/redis-keys.ts');
  const { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME } = await load('src/lib/session-auth.ts');

  const park = async (owner: number, grant: Row = { scopes: [READ, EVENTS] }): Promise<string> => {
    const id: string = await connect.createPendingGoogleToken(owner, `rt-${owner}`, grant);
    ids.push(id);
    return id;
  };
  const ask = (id: string, cookie?: string, extra: Row = {}) => route.POST(request('/api/oauth/claim', { body: { token: id, peek: true }, cookie, ...extra }));
  const finish = (id: unknown, cookie?: string, extra: Row = {}) => route.POST(request('/api/oauth/claim', { body: { token: id }, cookie, ...extra }));
  const tokenOf = (id: number): string => (userRow(id).googleRefreshToken ? decrypt(userRow(id).googleRefreshToken) : '');

  await check('#1 the check (POST { token, peek: true }) says { mine: true } for the owner\'s live session and { mine: false } for no session, another account, a tampered cookie, an ended session, an id that is no id and a used entry; never anything else, never cached, and it never uses the entry up; the route has no GET, so the id is never in a URL', async () => {
    seed();
    assert(!('GET' in route), 'the route still has a GET handler');
    const id = await park(NOA);
    const noa = await sessionCookie(NOA, 'google');
    const yes = await ask(id, noa);
    assert(yes.status === 200 && show(await body(yes)) === show({ mine: true }), `the owner: ${yes.status} ${show(await body(yes))}`);
    assert(yes.headers.get('cache-control') === 'no-store', `cache-control ${yes.headers.get('cache-control')}`);
    const others: [string, string | undefined][] = [['no session', undefined], ['another account', await sessionCookie(TAL, 'google')], ['a tampered cookie', `${noa}x`]];
    for (const [label, cookie] of others) {
      const answer = await body(await ask(id, cookie));
      assert(show(answer) === show({ mine: false }), `${label}: ${show(answer)}`);
    }
    assert(show(await body(await ask('short', noa))) === show({ mine: false }), 'an id that is no id');
    userRow(NOA).sessionsValidAfter = new Date();
    assert(show(await body(await ask(id, noa))) === show({ mine: false }), 'an ended session');
    userRow(NOA).sessionsValidAfter = null;
    assert(pendingKeys().length === 1, `the checks used the entry up: ${show(pendingKeys())}`);
    redisStore.delete(pendingKeys()[0]);
    assert(show(await body(await ask(id, noa))) === show({ mine: false }), 'a used entry');

    assert(res.status === 200 && b.ok === true && b.page === 'select-calendars' && b.userId === NOA, `${res.status} ${show(b)}`);
    assert(b.redirect === `https://famcal.bot/he/select-calendars?user_id=${NOA}`, `redirect ${b.redirect}`);
    assert(tokenOf(NOA) === `rt-${NOA}` && userRow(NOA).googleRefreshToken !== `rt-${NOA}`, 'the token is not saved, encrypted, on the owner');
    assert(show(userRow(NOA).googleScopes) === show([READ, EVENTS]), `scopes ${show(userRow(NOA).googleScopes)}`);
    assert(redisStore.has(REDIS_KEYS.googleConnected(NOA)), 'no connected flag for the Mini App\'s poll');
    for (const step of [`reminder-cache:${NOA}`, `setup-tracks:${NOA}`, `stamp:${NOA}`, `activity:${NOA}:calendar_connected`]) {
      assert(followUps.includes(step), `the commit did not run ${step}: ${show(followUps)}`);

    assert(pendingKeys().length === 0, 'the entry is still there');

    seed();
    const id = await park(NOA, { scopes: [READ, EVENTS, SYNC], sync: { nativeCalendarId: 'cal-1', googleAccount: null } });
    const b = await body(await finish(id, await sessionCookie(NOA, 'google')));
    assert(b.ok === true && b.page === 'calendars' && b.redirect === `https://famcal.bot/he/calendars?user_id=${NOA}`, show(b));
    assert(followUps.includes(`enable-sync:${NOA}:cal-1`) && followUps.includes(`restore-sync:${NOA}`), show(followUps));
  });

  await check('#4 POST with another account\'s session uses the entry up and connects nothing on either account (not_owner); the owner\'s press after it says expired', async () => {
    seed();
    const id = await park(NOA);
    const res = await finish(id, await sessionCookie(TAL, 'tg'));
    assert(res.status === 403 && show(await body(res)) === show({ ok: false, error: 'not_owner' }), `${res.status} ${show(await body(res))}`);
    assert(tokenOf(NOA) === '' && tokenOf(TAL) === '' && pendingKeys().length === 0 && followUps.length === 0, `connected ${show([tokenOf(NOA), tokenOf(TAL), followUps])}`);
    const late = await finish(id, await sessionCookie(NOA, 'google'));
    assert(late.status === 410 && (await body(late)).error === 'expired', `the owner after it: ${late.status} ${show(await body(late))}`);
  });

  await check('#5 POST with no session, or an ended one (its cookie cleared), is signed-out and leaves the entry, which the chat claim still connects (Telegram\'s /start gc_<id>)', async () => {
    seed();
    const id = await park(TAL);
    const none = await finish(id);
    assert(none.status === 401 && show(await body(none)) === show({ ok: false, error: 'signed-out' }), `no session: ${none.status} ${show(await body(none))}`);
    userRow(TAL).sessionsValidAfter = new Date();
    const ended = await finish(id, await sessionCookie(TAL, 'tg'));
    assert(ended.status === 401 && (await body(ended)).error === 'signed-out', `ended: ${ended.status} ${show(await body(ended))}`);
    assert(ended.cookies.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value === '', `the ended cookie is not cleared: ${show(ended.cookies.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME))}`);
    assert(pendingKeys().length === 1 && tokenOf(TAL) === '', 'a signed-out press used the entry up or connected');
    await connect.handleGoogleConnectTelegram(TAL_TG, TAL_TG, id, 'en');
    assert(tokenOf(TAL) === `rt-${TAL}` && pendingKeys().length === 0, 'the chat claim did not connect it');
    assert(sent.length === 1 && sent[0].chatId === String(TAL_TG) && sent[0].text.includes('Google Calendar is connected'), `the chat reply ${show(sent)}`);
  });

  await check('#6 the check or the claim from another site, with no Origin, or with no id is refused, and the entry stays', async () => {
    seed();
    const id = await park(NOA);
    const cookie = await sessionCookie(NOA, 'google');
    const peekEvil = await ask(id, cookie, { origin: 'https://evil.example' });
    assert(peekEvil.status === 403 && (await body(peekEvil)).error === 'cross_site', `the check from another site: ${peekEvil.status} ${show(await body(peekEvil))}`);
    const evil = await finish(id, cookie, { origin: 'https://evil.example' });
    assert(evil.status === 403 && (await body(evil)).error === 'cross_site', `another site: ${evil.status} ${show(await body(evil))}`);

    assert(pendingKeys().length === 1 && tokenOf(NOA) === '', 'a refused press touched the entry');

  await check('#7 a commit that throws half-way answers failed (500), captured with the user id', async () => {

    const id = await park(NOA);

    assert(res.status === 500 && (await body(res)).error === 'failed', `${res.status} ${show(await body(res))}`);

  await check('#8 no console line or capture of the run holds a waiting connection\'s id', () => {

  });

  report();
}

main().catch(err => {
  console.error(err);

});
```

```ts
/** Park a token from the OAuth callback, with what Google granted, for its owner's tap. Returns the pendingId. */
export async function createPendingGoogleToken(ownerUserId: number, refreshToken: string, grant?: GoogleGrant): Promise<string> {
  const pendingId = crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('base64url');
  const entry: PendingGoogleToken = {
    ownerUserId,
    refreshToken: encrypt(refreshToken),
    ...(grant
      ? { scopes: grant.scopes, ...(grant.sync ? { sync: grant.sync } : {}), ...(grant.accountKey ? { accountKey: grant.accountKey } : {}) }
      : {}),
  };

  return pendingId;
}
```

After:
```ts
/** Park a token from the OAuth callback, with what Google granted, for its owner's tap. Returns the pendingId. */
export async function createPendingGoogleToken(ownerUserId: number, refreshToken: string, grant?: GoogleGrant): Promise<string> {
  const pendingId = crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('base64url');
  const entry: PendingGoogleToken = {
    ownerUserId,
    refreshToken: encrypt(refreshToken),
    ...(grant
      ? { scopes: grant.scopes, ...(grant.sync ? { sync: grant.sync } : {}), ...(grant.accountKey ? { accountKey: grant.accountKey } : {}) }
      : {}),
  };
  await redis.set(pendingKey(pendingId), JSON.stringify(entry), { ex: PENDING_TTL_SECONDS });
  return pendingId;
}

/**
 * Who started a waiting connection, read without using it up (GET, never GETDEL): the finish page's Finish here check
 * (POST /api/oauth/claim { token, peek: true }, web sign-up spec §3.10). null for an id that is not one and for an entry that is gone. The
 * answer stays on the server: the route says only whether it is this browser's own account.
 */
export async function peekPendingOwner(pendingId: string): Promise<number | null> {
  if (!PENDING_ID.test(pendingId)) return null;
  const raw = await redis.get<PendingGoogleToken | string>(pendingKey(pendingId));
  if (!raw) return null;
  const entry: PendingGoogleToken = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
  const owner = Number(entry.ownerUserId);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(owner) && owner > 0 ? owner : null;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The route (`app/api/oauth/claim/route.ts`, new)**

```ts
// POST /api/oauth/claim: Finish here, the browser's way to finish a Google Calendar connect (web sign-up spec §2.10,
// §3.10). The OAuth callback parked the token for the account that started the consent (google-connect.ts, R3); the
// chat claim (gc_<id> from the owner's own Telegram or WhatsApp) still works beside this. Both calls are this site's and
// JSON (refuseCrossSite), and the id rides in the body only: never in a URL, which a server's HTTP log may record.
//
// - { token, peek: true } → { mine }: whether this browser's session is that account, read without using the entry up
//   (peekPendingOwner), and checked in full (verifyUserAuth) only when the ids match. It never says whose it is. The
//   finish page asks it to show Finish here.
// - { token } → claimPendingGoogleToken(token, { userId }) for the session's account, checked in full first: with no
//   session, or one that has ended, it answers signed-out before the entry is touched, so the chat claim can still
//   finish it; a live session of another account uses the entry up and connects nothing, as the chat claim from
//   someone else does.
//   → { ok: true, page, userId, redirect } (the page the chat claim leads to: Select calendars, or Calendars after a copy
//   to Google) | { ok: false, error: 'not_owner' (403) | 'expired' (410; 400 for a body with no id) | 'signed-out' (401)
//   | 'failed' (500) }.
// The id rides as `token`, a name the Sentry scrubber drops, and is in no log line: the user id and the outcome only.

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { verifyUserAuth } from '@/src/lib/api-auth';
import { captureError } from '@/src/lib/error-capture';
import { settingsRateLimiter } from '@/src/lib/rate-limit';
import { refuseCrossSite } from '@/src/lib/same-origin';
import { clearSessionCookie, readSession } from '@/src/lib/session-auth';
import { appPageUrl } from '@/src/lib/web-session';
import { claimPendingGoogleToken, peekPendingOwner } from '@/src/services/google-connect';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

type ClaimError = 'not_owner' | 'expired' | 'signed-out' | 'failed';
const STATUS: Record<ClaimError, number> = { not_owner: 403, expired: 410, 'signed-out': 401, failed: 500 };

function refuse(error: ClaimError, status: number = STATUS[error]): NextResponse {
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error }, { status });
}

/** The check: whether this browser's live session is the account that started the consent. */
async function peek(request: NextRequest, token: string): Promise<NextResponse> {
  const answer = (mine: boolean) => NextResponse.json({ mine }, { headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } });
  try {
    const session = readSession(request);
    if (!session) return answer(false);
    const owner = await peekPendingOwner(token);
    if (owner === null || owner !== session.userId) return answer(false);
    // The ids match: the session must still be good (not ended, not suspended), or Finish here would only fail
    const auth = await verifyUserAuth(request, String(session.userId), null, settingsRateLimiter, 'oauth-claim-check');
    if (auth.success) console.log(`[oauth-claim] user ${auth.user.id}: this browser may finish the Google connect here`);
    return answer(auth.success);
  } catch (error) {
    captureError(error, 'oauth-claim-check');
    return answer(false);
  }
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const crossSite = refuseCrossSite(request);
  if (crossSite) return crossSite;
  let userId: number | undefined;
  try {
    let body: { token?: unknown; peek?: unknown } | null;
    try {
      body = await request.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`[oauth-claim] a Finish here whose body is not JSON (${error instanceof Error ? error.name : typeof error})`);
      return refuse('expired', 400);
    }
    const token = body?.token;
    if (typeof token !== 'string') {
      console.warn('[oauth-claim] a Finish here with no connection id');
      return refuse('expired', 400);
    }
    if (body?.peek === true) return await peek(request, token);
    const session = readSession(request);
    if (!session) {
      console.log('[oauth-claim] Finish here with no session in this browser; the connection is left for the chat claim');
      return refuse('signed-out');
    }
    const auth = await verifyUserAuth(request, String(session.userId), null, settingsRateLimiter, 'oauth-claim');
    if (!auth.success) {
      if (auth.response.status === 429) return auth.response;
      // verifyUserAuth logged why (ended, suspended, no row); the refused cookie is cleared, and the entry is left
      const signedOut = refuse('signed-out');
      clearSessionCookie(signedOut);
      return signedOut;
    }
    userId = auth.user.id;
    const claim = await claimPendingGoogleToken(token, { userId });
    if (claim.status === 'not_owner') {
      console.warn(`[oauth-claim] user ${userId}: Finish here on a connection another account started; it is used up and nothing was connected`);
      return refuse('not_owner');
    }
    if (claim.status === 'expired') {
      console.log(`[oauth-claim] user ${userId}: Finish here on a connection that was used or has expired`);
      return refuse('expired');
    }
    const { owner } = claim;
    const page = claim.sync ? 'calendars' : 'select-calendars';
    console.log(`[oauth-claim] user ${owner.id}: the Google ${claim.sync ? 'copy' : 'connect'} was finished in the browser`);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, page, userId: owner.id, redirect: appPageUrl(owner.language, page, owner.id) });
  } catch (error) {
    // The commit can fail half-way, after the token is saved: the page says to check, never that nothing was connected
    captureError(error, 'google-connect-claim', { user_id: userId });
    return refuse('failed');
  }
}
```

```ts
  await check('F5 a consent this browser did not start (the check says not mine) with no chat button: "Sign in to finish" with Sign in (/signin in the page\'s language), never the incomplete card; the question is one POST to /api/oauth/claim with { token, peek: true } as JSON and the cookie, the id in no URL', async () => {
    const problems: string[] = [];
    for (const l of LOCALES) {
      const t = messages[l].oauthComplete;
      const { m, b } = await mountHere(l, `#p=${PENDING}&b=`, false);
      const h1 = all(m).find((e: Row) => e.localName === 'h1');
      const link = all(m).find((e: Row) => e.localName === 'a') as Row | undefined;
      const asked = b.calls.filter((c) => c.path.startsWith('/api/oauth/claim'));
      if (!h1 || textOf(h1) !== t.signInTitle || !all(m).some((e: Row) => textOf(e) === t.signInBody)) problems.push(`${l}: ${h1 ? textOf(h1) : 'no h1'}`);
      if (!link || link.getAttribute('href') !== (l === 'en' ? '/signin' : `/${l}/signin`) || textOf(link) !== t.signInButton) problems.push(`${l}: the link ${link ? link.getAttribute('href') : 'none'}`);
      if (asked.length !== 1 || asked[0].method !== 'POST' || asked[0].path !== '/api/oauth/claim' || show(asked[0].body) !== show({ token: PENDING, peek: true }) || asked[0].headers['content-type'] !== 'application/json' || asked[0].credentials !== 'same-origin') problems.push(`${l}: the question ${show(asked)}`);
      if (l !== 'en') {
        const english = englishIn(visibleText(serialize(m.container)));
        if (english.length) problems.push(`${l}: English ${show(english)}`);
      }
      m.unmount();
      leaveBrowser();
    }
    assert(problems.length === 0, problems.join('; '));
  });

  await check('F6 this browser is the account that started it: the loader while the page asks; then Finish here (the first control, the primary) with the chat buttons outlined under it; a press posts { token } as JSON with the cookie and goes to the page the server names (this site only); not_owner, expired and signed-out each say why in an error notice and take Finish here away (the chat buttons stay); a request that never arrived says so and keeps it; a page off this site is refused', async () => {
    const problems: string[] = [];
    for (const l of LOCALES) {
      const t = messages[l].oauthComplete;
      const hanging = await mountHere(l, `#p=${PENDING}&b=tg%2Cwa`, 'hang');
      if (!all(hanging.m).some((e: Row) => String(e.getAttribute('class')).includes('ch-loader')) || controlsOf(hanging.m).length) problems.push(`${l}: no loader while the page asks`);
      hanging.m.unmount();
      leaveBrowser();

      const { m, b, assigned } = await mountHere(l, `#p=${PENDING}&b=tg%2Cwa`, true);
      const here = buttonNamed(m, t.hereButton);
      const links = all(m).filter((e: Row) => e.localName === 'a') as Row[];
      if (!here || controlsOf(m)[0] !== here || !String(here.getAttribute('class')).includes('ch-btn-primary')) problems.push(`${l}: Finish here is not the first, primary control`);
      if (links.length !== 2 || links.some((a) => !String(a.getAttribute('class')).includes('ch-btn-outline'))) problems.push(`${l}: the chat buttons ${show(links.map((a) => a.getAttribute('class')))}`);
      b.answer['/api/oauth/claim'] = [() => json({ ok: true, page: 'select-calendars', userId: 7, redirect: 'https://app.example.test/he/select-calendars?user_id=7' })];
      if (here) m.click(here);
      await settle();
      const post = b.calls.find((c) => c.method === 'POST' && c.path === '/api/oauth/claim' && c.body?.peek !== true);
      if (!post || show(post.body) !== show({ token: PENDING }) || post.headers['content-type'] !== 'application/json' || post.credentials !== 'same-origin') problems.push(`${l}: the press ${show(post)}`);
      if (show(assigned) !== show(['https://app.example.test/he/select-calendars?user_id=7'])) problems.push(`${l}: went to ${show(assigned)}`);
      m.unmount();
      leaveBrowser();

      for (const [error, key] of [['not_owner', 'hereNotOwner'], ['expired', 'hereExpired'], ['signed-out', 'hereSignedOut']] as const) {

        r.b.answer['/api/oauth/claim'] = [() => json({ ok: false, error }, error === 'signed-out' ? 401 : error === 'expired' ? 410 : 403)];
        r.m.click(buttonNamed(r.m, t.hereButton) as Row);
        await settle();
        const notice = errorNotice(r.m);

        if (!notice || textOf(notice) !== t[key] || buttonNamed(r.m, t.hereButton) || !telegram || r.assigned.length) problems.push(`${l} ${error}: ${notice ? textOf(notice) : 'no notice'}`);
        r.m.unmount();

      lost.m.unmount();

      away.b.answer['/api/oauth/claim'] = [() => json({ ok: true, page: 'select-calendars', userId: 7, redirect: 'https://evil.example/x' })];
      away.m.click(buttonNamed(away.m, t.hereButton) as Row);
      await settle();

    assert(problems.length === 0, problems.join('; '));
  });

  await check('F7 an account with no chat (b= empty) that started it in this browser: Finish here alone, never the incomplete card; while the press is out it waits (disabled, "Connecting…")', async () => {
    const problems: string[] = [];
    for (const l of LOCALES) {
      const t = messages[l].oauthComplete;
      const { m, b } = await mountHere(l, `#p=${PENDING}&b=`, true);
      const controls = controlsOf(m);
      if (controls.length !== 1 || textOf(controls[0]) !== t.hereButton || all(m).some((e: Row) => textOf(e) === t.incompleteTitle)) problems.push(`${l}: ${show(controls.map((c) => textOf(c)))}`);
      b.answer['/api/oauth/claim'] = [() => new Promise<Response>(() => undefined)];
      if (controls[0]) m.click(controls[0]);
      await settle();
      const busy = controlsOf(m)[0];
      if (!busy || !busy.hasAttribute('disabled') || busy.getAttribute('aria-busy') !== 'true' || textOf(busy) !== t.hereBusy) problems.push(`${l}: no busy state while the press is out`);
      m.unmount();
      leaveBrowser();
    }
    assert(problems.length === 0, problems.join('; '));
  });
```

- [ ] **Step 8: The finish page (`app/(connect)/oauth-complete/OAuthCompleteClient.tsx`, replace the whole file)**

```tsx
'use client';

// /oauth-complete in the app's design (plan W4-3): one more tap to finish connecting Google, here in this browser (web
// sign-up spec §2.10, §3.10) or in Telegram or WhatsApp. It always opens in a browser (after Google's consent), so its
// look follows the browser's light or dark.
//
// - Before the fragment is read (the server's render and the first paint), and while the page asks whether this browser
//   is signed in as the account that started the consent (POST /api/oauth/claim { token, peek: true }), the app's
//   loader, never an empty card.
// - Ready: an AppScreen on the grouped ground (the owner line is a notice on a card): a success icon, the title and the
//   subtitle, the owner line ({name} through next-intl); then Finish here (the primary) when this browser is that account,
//   and the buttons the fragment's b= allows: Finish in Telegram (the primary when there is no Finish here, else
//   outlined), Finish in WhatsApp (outlined beside Telegram or under Finish here, else the primary) with its hint under it.
// - Finish here posts the id (POST /api/oauth/claim, this site and JSON); the server commits it only for that account and
//   names the page to go to (this site only). A refusal says why in an error notice and takes Finish here away (the
//   connection is used up, or this browser's sign-in ended); a request that never reached the server keeps it.
// - Not that account and no chat button (an account made on famcal.bot, in a browser not signed in as it): Sign in to
//   finish, with Sign in.
// - A fragment that is missing or bad: the kit's state card, "This link is incomplete".
//
// The pendingId, the owner's first name and the buttons are in the URL fragment (finishPageUrl), which only this
// client reads; the id goes to this site's own route in a POST body as `token` (a name the Sentry scrubber drops), never
// in a URL, and no log line here holds it. Words: oauthComplete.* and pageGate.loading (the page's provider).

import { useEffect, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { CircleCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { AppScreen } from '@/components/app-ui/AppScreen';
import { FORM_CSS } from '@/components/app-ui/form-kit';
import { Notice } from '@/components/app-ui/Notice';
import { StateCard } from '@/components/app-ui/StateCard';
import { readJsonBody } from '@/src/lib/read-json';
import { signInHref } from '@/src/site/signin';
import { CONNECT_CSS } from '../connect-css';
import { ConnectHero, ConnectLoader } from '../connect-ui';

/** What the claim buttons say. */
export interface FinishButtonWords {
  telegramButton: string;
  whatsappButton: string;
  /** Under the WhatsApp button: nothing is connected until that message is sent */
  whatsappHint: string;
}

interface OAuthCompleteClientProps {
  botUsername: string;
  waNumber: string;
}

/** What the OAuth callback put in the fragment: #p=<pendingId>&n=<first name>&b=tg,wa */
export interface FinishParams {
  pendingId: string;
  ownerName: string;
  telegram: boolean;
  whatsapp: boolean;
}

const PENDING_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32}$/;
const TAG = '[oauth-complete]';

export function parseFinishFragment(hash: string): FinishParams | null {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(hash.replace(/^#/, ''));
  const pendingId = params.get('p') ?? '';
  if (!PENDING_ID.test(pendingId)) return null;
  const buttons = (params.get('b') ?? '').split(',');
  return { pendingId, ownerName: params.get('n') ?? '', telegram: buttons.includes('tg'), whatsapp: buttons.includes('wa') };
}

/**
 * The claim links: the bot's /start gc_<id>, and a WhatsApp message that contains gc_<id>.
 * A button shows only when the owner has that channel and it is configured.
 */
export function finishLinks(
  params: FinishParams,
  botUsername: string,
  waNumber: string,
  waText: string,
): { telegram?: string; whatsapp?: string } {
  const code = `gc_${params.pendingId}`;
  return {
    ...(params.telegram && botUsername ? { telegram: `https://t.me/${botUsername}?start=${code}` } : {}),
    ...(params.whatsapp && waNumber
      ? { whatsapp: `https://wa.me/${waNumber}?text=${encodeURIComponent(waText.replace('{code}', code))}` }
      : {}),
  };
}

/**
 * The claim buttons. Telegram is the primary; WhatsApp is outlined beside it and the primary alone. Under Finish here
 * (`secondary`) both are outlined. WhatsApp only prefills the message, so its hint under it says to send it.
 */
export function FinishButtons({
  links,
  translations: t,
  secondary = false,
}: {
  links: { telegram?: string; whatsapp?: string };
  translations: FinishButtonWords;
  secondary?: boolean;
}) {
  const whatsappPrimary = !secondary && !links.telegram;
  return (
    <div className="ch-connect-actions">
      {links.telegram ? (
        <a className={`ch-btn ${secondary ? 'ch-btn-outline' : 'ch-btn-primary'} ch-save`} href={links.telegram}>
          {t.telegramButton}
        </a>
      ) : null}
      {links.whatsapp ? (
        <>
          <a className={`ch-btn ${whatsappPrimary ? 'ch-btn-primary' : 'ch-btn-outline'} ch-save`} href={links.whatsapp}>
            {t.whatsappButton}
          </a>
          <p className="ch-form-fixed">{t.whatsappHint}</p>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

const subscribeToHash = (onChange: () => void) => {
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', onChange);
  return () => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onChange);
};

/** What a refused Finish here says: a key of oauthComplete. */
type Problem = 'hereNotOwner' | 'hereExpired' | 'hereSignedOut' | 'hereFailed' | 'hereNetwork';
const REFUSALS: Record<string, Problem> = { not_owner: 'hereNotOwner', expired: 'hereExpired', 'signed-out': 'hereSignedOut' };

/** Whether this browser's session is the account that started the consent; null while the page asks (no id: false). */
function useMine(pendingId: string | null): boolean | null {
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState<{ id: string; mine: boolean } | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pendingId) return;
    let live = true;
    void (async () => {
      let mine = false;
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/oauth/claim', {
          method: 'POST',
          credentials: 'same-origin',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ token: pendingId, peek: true }),
        });
        const body = await readJsonBody(res, `${TAG} the Finish here check`);
        if (!res.ok) console.warn(`${TAG} the Finish here check answered ${res.status}`);
        mine = res.ok && body?.mine === true;
      } catch (error) {
        // The chat buttons still work: the page shows them as if this browser were not the account
        console.error(`${TAG} the Finish here check failed:`, error instanceof Error ? error.name : typeof error);
      }
      if (live) setAnswer({ id: pendingId, mine });
    })();
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [pendingId]);
  if (!pendingId) return false;
  return answer?.id === pendingId ? answer.mine : null;
}

export default function OAuthCompleteClient({ botUsername, waNumber }: OAuthCompleteClientProps) {
  const t = useTranslations('oauthComplete');
  const gate = useTranslations('pageGate');
  const locale = useLocale();
  // The fragment exists only in the browser; the server render has none (null)
  const hash = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeToHash, () => window.location.hash, () => null);
  const params = hash === null ? null : parseFinishFragment(hash);
  const mine = useMine(params?.pendingId ?? null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<Problem | null>(null);
  // A refused Finish here: the connection is used up, or this browser's sign-in ended
  const [hereGone, setHereGone] = useState(false);

  if (hash === null || (params && mine === null)) {
    return (
      <AppScreen ground="grouped">
        <ConnectLoader label={gate('loading')} />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }
  // The message as written, {code} and all: finishLinks puts the claim code in
  const links = params ? finishLinks(params, botUsername, waNumber, t.raw('whatsappText') as string) : {};
  const chat = Boolean(links.telegram || links.whatsapp);
  if (!params) {
    return (
      <AppScreen>
        <StateCard tone="crash" title={t('incompleteTitle')} body={t('incompleteBody')} />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }
  if (!mine && !chat) {
    return (
      <AppScreen>
        <StateCard tone="crash" title={t('signInTitle')} body={t('signInBody')} action={{ label: t('signInButton'), href: signInHref(locale) }} />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }
  const here = mine === true && !hereGone;

  const finishHere = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setProblem(null);
    let leaving = false;
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/oauth/claim', {
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ token: params.pendingId }),
      });
      const body = await readJsonBody(res, `${TAG} Finish here`);
      if (res.ok && body?.ok === true && typeof body.redirect === 'string') {
        // The server names the page; it is always this site's
        if (new URL(body.redirect, window.location.origin).origin === window.location.origin) {
          leaving = true;
          window.location.assign(body.redirect);
          return;
        }
        console.error(`${TAG} Finish here named a page off this site`);
        setProblem('hereFailed');
        setHereGone(true);
        return;
      }
      console.warn(`${TAG} Finish here answered ${res.status}`);
      if (res.status === 429) {
        // Too many requests: nothing was used up, so it can be pressed again
        setProblem('hereNetwork');
        return;
      }
      setProblem(REFUSALS[String(body?.error)] ?? 'hereFailed');
      setHereGone(true);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`${TAG} Finish here failed:`, error instanceof Error ? error.name : typeof error);
      setProblem('hereNetwork');
    } finally {
      if (!leaving) setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AppScreen ground="grouped">
      <style>{FORM_CSS}</style>
      <style>{CONNECT_CSS}</style>
      <div className="ch-form-page ch-form-page-grouped">
        <ConnectHero icon={<CircleCheck aria-hidden="true" />} title={t('title')} lead={t('subtitle')} />
        <Notice>{params.ownerName ? t('owner', { name: params.ownerName }) : t('ownerUnnamed')}</Notice>
        {problem ? <Notice tone="error">{t(problem)}</Notice> : null}
        {here ? (
          <div className="ch-connect-actions">
            <button type="button" className="ch-btn ch-btn-primary ch-save" disabled={busy} aria-busy={busy || undefined} onClick={finishHere}>
              {busy ? t('hereBusy') : t('hereButton')}
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {chat ? (
          <FinishButtons
            links={links}
            secondary={here}
            translations={{ telegramButton: t('telegramButton'), whatsappButton: t('whatsappButton'), whatsappHint: t('whatsappHint') }}
          />
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}
```

```ts
// Smoke test for the partner invite on the web (web sign-up spec 2026-11-03 §2.14, §3.7; plan 6c-1 Task 11).
//
// What it pins:
//   - the landing for an invite is /{locale}/invite/{token}, with no user_id, and every other finish is the calendar
//     (Task 4's smoke pins cleanInviteToken itself);
//   - a browser signed in on famcal.bot accepts with its cookie (no initData): the pairing is made and the inviter told;
//     a session that was ended gets 401 with the cookie cleared, and one for another account 401, with nothing paired;
//   - Accept and the invite's own POST and DELETE come only from famcal.bot (another Origin, or none: 403), and a
//     same-site invite still works;
//   - an inviter with no chat: the accept works, nothing is sent, and the skip is logged; the chat accept's notice
//     failure is logged too (no empty catch);
//   - signed out, the round trip lands on the invite through each way: Telegram and Google (the invite in the start
//     route's flow record), an email code (in the email flow's record), and a sign-up by email and by Google (carried
//     into the sign-up record); never in the provider's URL or a cookie's value;
//   - a token that is not one is dropped at the start (Telegram, Google, email) and the finish is the calendar;
//   - an invite revoked, or accepted by someone else, while its visitor signs up: the account is still made, with no
//     pairing, and lands on the invite, whose page then shows its invalid card (Review Focus 4);
//   - the token is in no console line and no capture; Sentry drops it from URLs, queries, JSON and form bodies, the
//     invite page's path, breadcrumbs and transaction names.
//
// Real: the pair routes, pairing-service (getInviteByToken, the invite page's one read), pair-handler, the start, callback, request, verify and sign-up routes,
// oidc-route, flow, the email code and its email, identities, google-signin, createAccount, finishSignIn, the session
// cookie, verifyUserAuth, the Origin guard, the limits, the Sentry scrubber. Faked at the boundaries
// (scripts/lib/signin-world.ts): Prisma and Redis in memory, the rate limiter, error capture, Telegram and WhatsApp
// (every send recorded), the OIDC exchange (scripted claims), analytics, fetch (Resend answered and recorded). No
// network, no DB.
//
// Run with the fake env of scripts/ci-smokes.sh:
//   bash /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-razielgershoni-development-famcalbot/0d239296-a217-49f9-8833-757c9d9a2df6/scratchpad/6c1/run-smoke.sh smoke-invite-web

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import {
  assert, baseUser, body, check, DB, drainAfter, everyCapture, everyLog, flowCookie, identityRow, initDataFor, installSigninWorld,
  load, logs, mails, redisStore, report, request, resetWorld, ROOT, sent, sessionCookie, show, stubModule, world, type Row,
} from './lib/signin-world';

const TAL = 9; // Telegram, English: the inviter
const TAL_TG = 111111111;
const NOA = 7; // made on famcal.bot, Google and email ways, Russian, no chat
const DANA = 42; // made on famcal.bot, an email way, Hebrew, no chat
const TOKEN = 'a1'.repeat(32); // an invite token as createInvite makes it: 64 lowercase hex
const DAY = 86_400_000;

function seed(o: { inviter?: number } = {}): void {
  resetWorld();
  DB.user = [
    baseUser({ id: TAL, name: 'Tal', telegramId: BigInt(TAL_TG) }),
    baseUser({ id: NOA, name: 'Noa', language: 'ru', location: '' }),
    baseUser({ id: DANA, name: 'Dana', language: 'he', location: '' }),
  ];
  DB.signInIdentity = [
    identityRow({ userId: NOA, kind: 'email', subject: 'noa@example.com', address: 'noa@example.com' }),
    identityRow({ userId: NOA, kind: 'google', subject: 'g-noa', address: 'noa@gmail.com' }),
    identityRow({ userId: DANA, kind: 'email', subject: 'dana@example.com', address: 'dana@example.com' }),
  ];
  DB.pairingInvite = [{
    id: 'inv-1', token: TOKEN, inviterUserId: o.inviter ?? TAL, createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - DAY),
    expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 6 * DAY), acceptedAt: null, revokedAt: null, acceptedByUserId: null,
  }];
  DB.pairing = [];
  DB.nativeCalendar = [];
}
const userRow = (id: number): Row => DB.user.find(u => u.id === id) as Row;
const location = (res: Row): string => res.headers.get('location') ?? '';
const pathOf = (url: string): string => {
  const u = new URL(url, 'https://famcal.bot');
  return `${u.pathname}${u.search}`;
};
/** The sign-in flow records in Redis (one per start), as stored */
const flowRecords = (): Row[] => [...redisStore.entries()].filter(([k]) => k.startsWith('signin:flow:')).map(([, v]) => JSON.parse(v));
function cookieOf(res: Row, name: string): string {
  const value = res.cookies.get(name)?.value;
  assert(value, `no ${name} cookie on the answer`);
  return `${name}=${value}`;
}
function codeIn(mail: Row | undefined): string {
  const m = /\b(\d{6})\b/.exec(JSON.stringify(mail?.body ?? {}));
  assert(m, `no 6-digit code in the mail: ${show(mail?.body)}`);
  return m[1];
}

async function main() {
  await installSigninWorld();
  stubModule('src/services/analytics-service.ts', {
    addBreadcrumb: () => undefined,
    setUserContext: () => undefined,
    trackActivityAsync: () => undefined,
    trackActivity: async () => undefined,
    ACTIVITY_RETENTION_DAYS: 90,
    ACTIVITY_PURGE_BATCH: 5000,
    purgeOldActivity: async () => 0,
  });
  const accept = await load('app/api/pair/accept/route.ts');
  const inviteRoute = await load('app/api/pair/invite/route.ts');
  const tgStart = await load('app/api/auth/telegram/start/route.ts');
  const tgCallback = await load('app/api/auth/telegram/callback/route.ts');
  const gStart = await load('app/api/auth/google/start/route.ts');
  const gCallback = await load('app/api/auth/google/callback/route.ts');
  const emailRequest = await load('app/api/auth/email/request/route.ts');
  const emailVerify = await load('app/api/auth/email/verify/route.ts');
  const signupRoute = await load('app/api/auth/signup/route.ts');
  const { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, validateSessionToken } = await load('src/lib/session-auth.ts');
  const { SIGNIN_COOKIE_NAME } = await load('src/services/web-signin/flow.ts');
  const { issueCode } = await load('src/services/web-signin/email-code.ts');
  const { emailKey, normalizeEmail } = await load('src/services/web-signin/email-address.ts');
  const scrub = await load('src/lib/sentry-scrub.ts');
  const { getInviteByToken } = await load('src/services/pairing-service.ts');

  const acceptAs = (userId: number, auth: { cookie?: string; initData?: string }, extra: Row = {}) =>
    accept.POST(request(`/api/pair/accept?user_id=${userId}`, { body: { token: TOKEN }, cookie: auth.cookie, initData: auth.initData, ...extra }));
  /** A start route, then the provider's answer to its callback: the start's answer, the flow records it made, the callback's answer */
  async function startThenBack(provider: 'telegram' | 'google', query: string) {
    const start = await (provider === 'telegram' ? tgStart : gStart).GET(request(`/api/auth/${provider}/start?${query}`));
    const state = new URL(location(start)).searchParams.get('state') ?? '';
    const cookie = cookieOf(start, SIGNIN_COOKIE_NAME);
    const records = flowRecords();
    const back = await (provider === 'telegram' ? tgCallback : gCallback).GET(request(`/api/auth/${provider}/callback?code=c-1&state=${encodeURIComponent(state)}`, { cookie }));
    return { start, cookie, records, back };
  }

  async function emailRoundTrip(requestBody: Row) {

    const cookie = cookieOf(asked, SIGNIN_COOKIE_NAME);
    const records = flowRecords();
    await drainAfter();
    const verified = await emailVerify.POST(request('/api/auth/email/verify', { body: { code: codeIn(mails.at(-1)) }, cookie }));
    return { records, verified, answer: await body(verified) };
  }

    assert(show(landingPage(TOKEN)) === show({ invite: TOKEN }) && landingPage(undefined) === 'dashboard' && landingPage('nope') === 'dashboard', 'landingPage');
  });

  await check('W2 a browser signed in on famcal.bot accepts with its cookie alone (no initData): the pairing is made, the answer names the inviter, the inviter is told in Telegram', async () => {
    seed();

    const pairing = DB.pairing[0];

    assert(userRow(TAL).pairingId === pairing.id && userRow(NOA).pairingId === pairing.id, 'the two are not linked');
    assert(sent.length === 1 && sent[0].chatId === String(TAL_TG), `sent ${show(sent)}`);
  });

    userRow(NOA).sessionsValidAfter = null;
    const other = await acceptAs(NOA, { cookie: await sessionCookie(DANA, 'email') });
    assert(other.status === 401, `another account's cookie: ${other.status}`);
    assert(DB.pairing.length === 0 && DB.pairingInvite[0].acceptedAt === null, `paired ${show(DB.pairing)}`);
  });

    const cookie = await sessionCookie(NOA, 'google');

      world.claims = { sub: 'g-noa', email: 'noa@gmail.com', emailVerified: true };
      const g = await startThenBack('google', `locale=ru&invite=${bad}`);
      assert(!('invite' in g.records[0]) && pathOf(location(g.back)) === `/ru/dashboard?user_id=${NOA}`, `Google ${bad}: ${location(g.back)}`);
    }
    seed();
    const e = await emailRoundTrip({ email: 'noa@example.com', locale: 'ru', invite: TOKEN.toUpperCase() });
    assert(!('invite' in e.records[0]) && pathOf(String(e.answer.redirect)) === `/ru/dashboard?user_id=${NOA}`, `email: ${show(e.records)} → ${show(e.answer)}`);
  });

  await check('W12 Sentry drops the token: from a URL and its query (string, object, pairs), a JSON or form body (and cut-off JSON), the invite page\'s path, the transaction name and the browser\'s breadcrumbs; the rest is kept', () => {
    const event = scrub.scrubServerEvent({
      request: {
        url: `https://famcal.bot/api/auth/google/start?locale=he&invite=${TOKEN}`,
        query_string: `locale=he&invite=${TOKEN}&invited=1`,
        data: JSON.stringify({ email: 'x@example.com', locale: 'he', invite: TOKEN }),
      },
      contexts: { nextjs: { request_path: `/he/invite/${TOKEN}` } },
    });
    assert(!show(event).includes(TOKEN), `the server event: ${show(event)}`);
    assert(String(event.request.query_string).includes('locale=he') && String(event.request.query_string).includes('invited=1'), `the rest: ${event.request.query_string}`);
    const obj = scrub.scrubServerEvent({ request: { query_string: { invite: TOKEN, locale: 'ru' } } }).request.query_string;
    assert(show(obj) === show({ invite: '[scrubbed]', locale: 'ru' }), `object ${show(obj)}`);
    const pairs = scrub.scrubServerEvent({ request: { query_string: [['invite', TOKEN], ['locale', 'ru']] } }).request.query_string;
    assert(show(pairs) === show([['invite', '[scrubbed]'], ['locale', 'ru']]), `pairs ${show(pairs)}`);
    for (const data of [`invite=${TOKEN}&locale=he`, `{"locale":"he","invite":"${TOKEN}`]) {
      const out = scrub.scrubServerEvent({ request: { data } }).request.data;
      assert(!String(out).includes(TOKEN) && String(out).includes('locale'), `body ${show(out)}`);
    }
    assert(scrub.scrubUrl(`https://famcal.bot/he/invite/${TOKEN}`) === 'https://famcal.bot/he/invite/[scrubbed]', scrub.scrubUrl(`https://famcal.bot/he/invite/${TOKEN}`));
    const transaction = scrub.scrubServerTransaction({ transaction: `GET /he/invite/${TOKEN}` });
    assert(transaction.transaction === 'GET /he/invite/[scrubbed]', `transaction ${transaction.transaction}`);
    const browser = scrub.scrubBrowserEvent({
      request: { url: `https://famcal.bot/invite/${TOKEN}` },
      breadcrumbs: [
        { category: 'navigation', data: { from: '/signin', to: `/he/invite/${TOKEN}` } },
        { category: 'fetch', data: { url: `/api/auth/telegram/start?locale=he&invite=${TOKEN}` } },
      ],
    });
    assert(!show(browser).includes(TOKEN), `the browser event: ${show(browser)}`);
  });

  await check('W13 an invite revoked, or accepted by someone else, while its visitor signs up with Google: Create account still makes the account, with no pairing, and lands on /he/invite/<token>, whose page shows its invalid card (getInviteByToken answers null)', async () => {
    for (const ending of ['revoked', 'used'] as const) {
      seed();
      world.claims = { sub: `g-${ending}`, email: `${ending}.person@gmail.com`, emailVerified: true };
      const { back } = await startThenBack('google', `locale=he&invite=${TOKEN}`);
      assert(new URL(location(back), 'https://famcal.bot').pathname === '/he/signup', `${ending}: the callback went to ${location(back)}`);
      if (ending === 'revoked') {
        DB.pairingInvite[0].revokedAt = new Date();
      } else {
        const taken = await acceptAs(DANA, { cookie: await sessionCookie(DANA, 'email') });
        assert(taken.status === 200 && (await body(taken)).success === true, `Dana's accept: ${taken.status} ${show(await body(taken))}`);
      }
      const pairings = DB.pairing.length;
      const made = await signupRoute.POST(request('/api/auth/signup', { body: { name: 'Avi' }, cookie: cookieOf(back, SIGNIN_COOKIE_NAME) }));
      const m = await body(made);
      assert(m.ok === true && pathOf(String(m.redirect)) === `/he/invite/${TOKEN}`, `${ending}: Create account ${made.status} ${show(m)}`);
      const fresh = DB.user.filter(u => ![TAL, NOA, DANA].includes(u.id));
      assert(fresh.length === 1 && !fresh[0].pairingId, `${ending}: the new account ${show(fresh)}`);
      assert(DB.pairing.length === pairings && !DB.pairing.some(p => p.inviteeUserId === fresh[0].id || p.inviterUserId === fresh[0].id), `${ending}: paired ${show(DB.pairing)}`);
      assert((await getInviteByToken(TOKEN)) === null, `${ending}: the invite page would still offer Accept`);
    }
  });

  await check('W14 no console line or capture of the run holds the token', () => {
    const lines = everyLog.filter(l => l.includes(TOKEN));
    const reports = everyCapture.filter(c => show(c).includes(TOKEN));
    assert(lines.length === 0 && reports.length === 0, `leaked: ${show(lines)} ${show(reports)}`);
  });

  report();
}

main().catch(err => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```ts
/**
```

```ts
 * or finished here in the browser: /api/oauth/claim); Calendars after a copy to Google finished here, as the chat
 * claim's button leads; the partner invite the sign-in began on (web sign-up spec §3.7); or the Join question an Add
 * Google ended on (§3.6; `join` is the question's one-time id).

export type FinishPage = 'dashboard' | 'select-calendars' | 'calendars' | { invite: string } | { join: string };
```

`appPageUrl` (Task 7's text), before:
```ts
/**
 * An app page of the person's, absolute: /{locale}/{page}?user_id={DB id}, in their language, with the locale prefix
 * for every language (an unknown language is English). The Join question is addGoogleJoinHref's page.
 */
export function appPageUrl(locale: string, page: FinishPage, userId: number): string {
  const path = typeof page === 'string' ? `/${page}?user_id=${userId}` : addGoogleJoinHref(locale, page.join);
  return new URL(prefixed(locale, path), getBaseUrl()).toString();
}
```
After:
```ts
/**
 * An app page of the person's, absolute: /{locale}/{page}?user_id={DB id}, in their language, with the locale prefix
 * for every language (an unknown language is English). The Join question is addGoogleJoinHref's page. An invite is
 * /{locale}/invite/{token}, with no user_id: the invite page reads the session cookie itself.
 */
export function appPageUrl(locale: string, page: FinishPage, userId: number): string {
  const path = typeof page === 'string' ? `/${page}?user_id=${userId}` : 'join' in page ? addGoogleJoinHref(locale, page.join) : `/invite/${page.invite}`;
  return new URL(prefixed(locale, path), getBaseUrl()).toString();
}

/**
 * Where a sign-in lands: back on the invite it began on (a sign-in flow's `invite`, a clean token only), else the
 * calendar. The one rule every finish reads (the Telegram and Google callbacks, the email code, the sign-up).
 */
export function landingPage(invite: string | undefined): FinishPage {
  const token = cleanInviteToken(invite);
  return token ? { invite: token } : 'dashboard';
}
```

`oidc-route.ts`, imports `:15`, before:

After:

`startOidcSignIn`, before:
```ts
/**
 * GET /api/auth/<provider>/start?locale=: a fresh state, nonce and PKCE verifier, kept for this browser for 10 minutes
 * (startFlow), then the provider's page. A way that isn't set up yet, or a provider that can't be reached, goes back to
 * /signin with its status.
 */
export async function startOidcSignIn(provider: OidcProvider, request: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse> {
  const locale = requestLocale(request, request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('locale'));
  if (!providerConfigured(provider)) {
    console.warn(`[signin] ${provider} sign-in was started but is not set up`);
    return toSignIn(locale, 'unavailable');
  }
  try {
    const checks = newOidcChecks();
    const response = NextResponse.redirect(await authorizationUrl(provider, checks));
    await startFlow(response, { kind: provider, ...checks, locale });
    return response;
```
After:
```ts
/**
 * GET /api/auth/<provider>/start?locale=&invite=: a fresh state, nonce and PKCE verifier, kept for this browser for 10
 * minutes (startFlow), then the provider's page. `invite` (the invite page's way in, 64 hex, else dropped) rides in the
 * same record, never in a return URL, and the finish lands back on it. A way that isn't set up yet, or a provider that
 * can't be reached, goes back to /signin with its status.
 */
export async function startOidcSignIn(provider: OidcProvider, request: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse> {
  const locale = requestLocale(request, request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('locale'));
  if (!providerConfigured(provider)) {
    console.warn(`[signin] ${provider} sign-in was started but is not set up`);
    return toSignIn(locale, 'unavailable');
  }
  try {
    const checks = newOidcChecks();
    const invite = cleanInviteToken(request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('invite'));
    const response = NextResponse.redirect(await authorizationUrl(provider, checks));
    await startFlow(response, { kind: provider, ...checks, locale, ...(invite ? { invite } : {}) });
    return response;
```

```ts
// POST /api/pair/accept — accept an invite as the authenticated user: Telegram initData, or the famcal.bot session
// cookie (the invite page signed in on the web, web sign-up spec §3.7). Body: { token, initData? }. Returns
// { success: true, partner: { name, englishName } }.
//
// A cookie can accept, so the request must come from famcal.bot as JSON (refuseCrossSite), or another site could make
// a signed-in browser accept its invite. Validation lives in pairing-service.acceptInvite — this route just maps the
// PairingError codes onto HTTP responses. The inviter is told about the accept here, through the same helper the chat
// accept uses (pair-handler).

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { verifyUserAuth } from '@/src/lib/api-auth';
import { requestInitData } from '@/src/lib/request-init-data';
import { settingsRateLimiter } from '@/src/lib/rate-limit';
import { refuseCrossSite } from '@/src/lib/same-origin';
import { acceptInvite, PairingError } from '@/src/services/pairing-service';
import { notifyInviterOfAccept } from '@/src/services/telegram/pair-handler';
import { captureError } from '@/src/lib/error-capture';
import { prisma } from '@/src/utils/prisma';

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const crossSite = refuseCrossSite(request);
  if (crossSite) return crossSite;
  let acceptingUserId: number | undefined;
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const userId = searchParams.get('user_id');
    const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const initData = requestInitData(request, body);
    const token: string | undefined = body.token;

    if (!token || typeof token !== 'string') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing token' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const auth = await verifyUserAuth(request, userId, initData, settingsRateLimiter, 'pair-accept');
    if (!auth.success) return auth.response;

    const user = auth.user;
    acceptingUserId = user.id;
```

`:49-60` as Task 5 left them (Task 5 added `name` to the three body lists), before:
```ts
/**
 * Query names whose value is a secret: the cron secret, image-link signatures, Meta's verify token, an OAuth code and
 * state, a one-time link's token, an id_token, and an email address.
 */
const SECRET_PARAM_NAMES = ['secret', 'sig', 'hub.verify_token', 'code', 'state', 'token', 'id_token', 'email'];
const SECRET_PARAM = /(^|[?&])(secret|sig|hub\.verify_token|code|state|token|id_token|email)=[^&#]*/gi;
/** Body fields dropped from a request body, any case: initData, sign-in's code, state, token, id_token and email, and a name. */
const SECRET_BODY_FIELDS = new Set(['initdata', 'code', 'state', 'token', 'id_token', 'email', 'name']);
/** The same fields as JSON members (a string, or a bare number or word), for JSON the SDK cut off at its size limit. */
const SECRET_JSON_MEMBER = /"(initData|code|state|token|id_token|email|name)"\s*:\s*(?:"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"?|[^,}\]\s]*)/gi;
/** And as fields of a form body. */
const SECRET_FORM_FIELD = /(^|&)(initData|code|state|token|id_token|email|name)=[^&]*/gi;
```
After:
```ts
/**
 * Query names whose value is a secret: the cron secret, image-link signatures, Meta's verify token, an OAuth code and
 * state, a one-time link's token, an id_token, an email address, and a partner invite's token.
 */
const SECRET_PARAM_NAMES = ['secret', 'sig', 'hub.verify_token', 'code', 'state', 'token', 'id_token', 'email', 'invite'];
const SECRET_PARAM = /(^|[?&])(secret|sig|hub\.verify_token|code|state|token|id_token|email|invite)=[^&#]*/gi;
/** Body fields dropped from a request body, any case: initData, sign-in's code, state, token, id_token, email and invite, and a name. */
const SECRET_BODY_FIELDS = new Set(['initdata', 'code', 'state', 'token', 'id_token', 'email', 'name', 'invite']);
/** The same fields as JSON members (a string, or a bare number or word), for JSON the SDK cut off at its size limit. */
const SECRET_JSON_MEMBER = /"(initData|code|state|token|id_token|email|name|invite)"\s*:\s*(?:"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"?|[^,}\]\s]*)/gi;
/** And as fields of a form body. */
const SECRET_FORM_FIELD = /(^|&)(initData|code|state|token|id_token|email|name|invite)=[^&]*/gi;
```

```ts
        world.accept = () => json({ success: false, error: 'SOMETHING_NEW' }, 400);
        odd.m.click(acceptOf(odd.m) as FakeElement);
        await settle();
        assert(show(noticesOf(odd.m).map(flat)) === show([word(locale, 'errorGenericWeb')]), `${locale}: an unknown code ${show(noticesOf(odd.m).map(flat))}`);
      } finally {
        close(odd);
      }
    }
    reset();
    const both = open('en', propsOf('en', { token: HEX, sessionUserId: 42 }), { telegram: {} });
    try {
      await settle();
      both.m.click(acceptOf(both.m) as FakeElement);
      await settle();
      assert(fetchCalls[0]?.url === `/api/pair/accept?user_id=${TG_ID}` && JSON.parse(String(fetchCalls[0].init.body)).initData === (both.tg as Row).initData, `inside Telegram: ${fetchCalls[0]?.url}`);
    } finally {
      close(both);
    }
  });
```

- [ ] **Step 18: `InviteClient` (`app/[locale]/(app)/invite/[token]/InviteClient.tsx`, replace the whole file)**

```tsx
'use client';

// Client-side invite landing, in the home's design (spec 2026-10-19 §4, §5; plan W3): an AppScreen with the card the app's
// states use (StateCard's classes), outside PageGate, because anyone with the link may see it.
//
// Five states:
//  1. Inside Telegram WebApp → one-tap accept via /api/pair/accept (uses initData)
//  2. Signed in on famcal.bot (the page read the session cookie: sessionUserId) → the same Accept, with the cookie and the
//     DB id as user_id (web sign-up spec §3.7); a 401 means the session has ended: the signed-out state, with a line
//     that says so
//  3. Signed out in a browser → "Sign in or create an account to accept" (/signin?invite=<token>: the sign-in or the
//     sign-up comes back here), then "Open in Telegram" + "Open in WhatsApp" for someone who already uses a bot
//  4. After a successful accept → confirmation card: Close inside Telegram, Open your calendar in a browser
//  5. The two are already paired with each other → that news in place of the button (information, not an error)
//
// - Whether this is Telegram is read after mount (window.Telegram is not there on the server), so the server's markup is
//   what the first client render draws too; Accept replaces the links once the effect has run. A signed-in browser's
//   Accept is in the server's markup already (the page knows the session). The expiry waits for the client as well: the
//   server does not know the device's timezone, and a time written in the server's would not match.
// - An error code from the accept route says its own message (ERROR_KEYS); anything else says "could not accept" (in a
//   browser without "try the bot"). A request that fails outright is said the same way, and reported (captureError).

import { useEffect, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { captureError } from '@/src/lib/error-capture';
import { formatDeviceDayTime } from '@/src/lib/calendar-view/device-time';
import { cleanInviteToken } from '@/src/lib/invite-token';
import { signInHref } from '@/src/site/signin';
import { localeHref } from '@/src/site/zmanim/links';
import { AppScreen } from '@/components/app-ui/AppScreen';
import { Notice } from '@/components/app-ui/Notice';
import { StateCard } from '@/components/app-ui/StateCard';
import { INVITE_CSS } from './invite-css';

interface Props {
  token: string;
  inviterName: string;
  locale: string;
  tgDeepLink: string;
  waDeepLink: string;
  expiresAt: string;
  /** The account this browser is signed in as on famcal.bot (the session cookie's signature and age only), or null */
  sessionUserId: number | null;
}

// Window.Telegram.WebApp is already typed in src/types/telegram-webapp.d.ts

type AcceptState = 'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'alreadyPaired' | 'error';

/** The invite error codes /api/pair/accept returns, and the invite.errors key that says each. */
const ERROR_KEYS: Record<string, string> = {
  INVITE_NOT_FOUND: 'errors.notFound',
  INVITE_EXPIRED: 'errors.expired',
  INVITE_ALREADY_USED: 'errors.alreadyUsed',
  INVITE_REVOKED: 'errors.revoked',
  CANNOT_ACCEPT_OWN_INVITE: 'errors.ownInvite',
  INVITER_ALREADY_PAIRED: 'errors.inviterAlreadyPaired',
  INVITEE_ALREADY_PAIRED: 'errors.inviteeAlreadyPaired',
  ALREADY_PAIRED_TOGETHER: 'errors.alreadyPairedTogether',
};

// The device's own timezone is not the server's: nothing is written for the expiry until the page is on the client.
const subscribe = () => () => {};
const noExpiryOnServer = () => null;

export default function InviteClient(props: Props) {
  const { token, inviterName, locale, tgDeepLink, waDeepLink, expiresAt } = props;
  const t = useTranslations('invite');
  const [state, setState] = useState<AcceptState>('idle');
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string>('');
  const [tgUser, setTgUser] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [tgInitData, setTgInitData] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // The accept route refused this browser's session (401): signed out from then on
  const [sessionEnded, setSessionEnded] = useState(false);
  const expires = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => formatDeviceDayTime(expiresAt, locale) || null, noExpiryOnServer);
  const webUser = sessionEnded ? null : props.sessionUserId ?? null;
  const viaTelegram = tgUser !== null && tgInitData !== null;
  // /signin with the invite, so the sign-in or the sign-up lands back here (a real token only)
  const invite = cleanInviteToken(token);
  const signInLink = invite ? `${signInHref(locale)}?invite=${invite}` : signInHref(locale);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Detect TG WebApp environment
    const tg = window.Telegram?.WebApp;
    if (tg?.initData && tg.initDataUnsafe?.user?.id) {
      tg.ready?.();
      tg.expand?.();
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- window.Telegram exists only on the client, so this must run after mount
      setTgInitData(tg.initData);
      setTgUser(tg.initDataUnsafe.user.id);
    }
  }, []);

  const accept = async () => {
    if (!viaTelegram && webUser === null) return;
    setState('pending');
    setErrorMessage('');
    const generic = viaTelegram ? t('errorGeneric') : t('errorGenericWeb');
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/pair/accept?user_id=${viaTelegram ? tgUser : webUser}`, {
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(viaTelegram ? { token, initData: tgInitData } : { token }),
      });
      if (!viaTelegram && res.status === 401) {
        // Signed out on all devices, a way removed, a suspension: this browser signs in again (its cookie was cleared)
        console.warn('[invite] the accept answered 401: this browser is signed out now');
        setSessionEnded(true);
        setState('idle');
        setErrorMessage(t('sessionEnded'));
        return;
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
        setState(data?.error === 'ALREADY_PAIRED_TOGETHER' ? 'alreadyPaired' : 'error');
        const key = ERROR_KEYS[data?.error];
        setErrorMessage(key ? t(key) : generic);
        return;
      }
      setState('success');
    } catch (error) {
      // A network failure: the user sees the generic error; the cause is logged and reported.
      captureError(error, 'invite-accept', { token_length: token.length }, 'warning');
      setState('error');
      setErrorMessage(generic);
    }
  };

  const pending = state === 'pending';
  const canAccept = viaTelegram || webUser !== null;
  const success = viaTelegram
    ? { label: t('closeApp'), onClick: () => window.Telegram?.WebApp?.close?.() }
    : { label: t('openCalendar'), href: localeHref(locale, `/dashboard?user_id=${props.sessionUserId}`) };

  return (
    <AppScreen>
      <style>{INVITE_CSS}</style>
      <div className="ch-invite-page">
        {state === 'success' ? (
          <StateCard title={t('success', { name: inviterName })} action={success} />
        ) : (
          <div className="ch-home-card">
            <h1 className="ch-home-card-title">{t('title', { name: inviterName })}</h1>
            <p className="ch-home-card-body">{t('subtitle')}</p>

            {errorMessage ? <Notice tone={state === 'alreadyPaired' ? 'info' : 'error'}>{errorMessage}</Notice> : null}

            {state === 'alreadyPaired' ? null : canAccept ? (
              <div className="ch-home-card-actions">
                <button type="button" className="ch-btn ch-btn-primary ch-home-card-action" disabled={pending} aria-busy={pending || undefined} onClick={accept}>
                  {pending ? t('accepting') : t('accept')}
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="ch-home-card-actions">
                  <a className="ch-btn ch-btn-primary ch-home-card-action" href={signInLink}>
                    {t('signInToAccept')}
                  </a>
                </div>
                {tgDeepLink || waDeepLink ? (
                  <>
                    <p className="ch-home-card-body">{t('notInApp')}</p>
                    <div className="ch-home-card-actions">
                      {tgDeepLink ? (
                        <a className="ch-btn ch-home-card-action" href={tgDeepLink}>
                          {t('openTg')}
                        </a>
                      ) : null}
                      {waDeepLink ? (
                        <a className="ch-btn ch-home-card-action" href={waDeepLink}>
                          {t('openWa')}
                        </a>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  </>
                ) : null}
              </>
            )}

            {expires ? <p className="ch-home-card-body ch-invite-expires">{t('expires', { when: expires })}</p> : null}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}
```

## Part H: Task 12 (fixes), Task 13 (website "Use in the browser"), Task 14 (legal text, docs, setup)

### Task 12: Fixes: the FamCal id on feedback, and every send skipped for want of a chat logs it

#### Notes for Tasks 12–14 (read first)

Read at main `edd9d72e`; every file:line below is from that commit. The draft's steps were run in a scratch copy of main (each new check failed before its code and passed after; Task 12's narrowed checks and Task 14's dated steps were edited after that run and are unrun), `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` was clean, eslint was clean on every touched file, and the smokes listed in each gate passed. `scripts/ci-smokes.sh` runs `scripts/smoke-*.ts` by glob, so a new smoke file needs no entry there. `$RUN` is the header's single-smoke runner (written by Task 1 Step 1.0). After every task the controller also runs `bash scripts/ci-smokes.sh`, `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` and `npm run lint`.

1. **"Has a chat" is `hasChat` (`src/lib/has-chat.ts`), created by Task 1.** No task of this part imports it: Task 12 keeps the guards that exist and needs no new chat test.
2. **The skip lines say what is missing.** The Done note and the trial-expired notice are Telegram-only sends. A WhatsApp-only account is skipped by them too, so their line ends `: no Telegram`. The format is `[<send>] skipped user <id>: no Telegram`, with the send named as `isPaused` names it (`trial-expired notice`, `done note`). The Google reconnect message goes to Telegram or WhatsApp, so its line ends `: no chat`, and it keeps the worker's own prefix beside its existing "unreachable; no reconnect message" line: `[google-sync] user <id>: no chat; no reconnect message`.
3. **What facts-partner item 7 got wrong, verified in the code:**
   - **The plan reminders already skip with a log line, and Task 12 does not touch them.** `subscription-reminders.ts:140-144` logs "Skipping user N - no messaging channel" and `continue`s before any send or `markReminderSent`; the expiry pass (`:302-306`) logs "Skipping expired user N - no Telegram ID". Both guards stay as they are (ruling #18: paying is Telegram only, so no browser-only account has a paid month to end), and so does the choice of who gets which send. The expiry gap for an account with no Telegram, and the renewal template for WhatsApp by BSUID alone, are out of the plan; the controller reports the first to the owner as a backlog finding.
   - **The alerts downgrade notice (`reminders.ts:487`) can't meet an account with no Telegram.** The 5-minute pass reads only the reminder cache, whose entries are `remindable` only with a Telegram id (`reminder-cache.ts:168`), and the pass itself has no `messagingPlatform` ("reminders go to Telegram only", `src/cron/handlers.ts:272`). `reminders.ts:422` is `sendReminder`'s Telegram branch, and its no-channel case already logs (`:438`). No change.
   - **The setup nudge (`src/cron/handlers.ts:500,509`) reads only accounts with a chat.** Both of its queries filter by `hasMessagingPlatform` (`:530-531`, used at `:556` and `:600`). No change.
   - **The summaries already log the skip** (`src/services/telegram/summary.ts:604-607`). No change.
   - **The Google reconnect message was silent** (`google-sync/worker.ts:467-469`, `return false` with no line). Task 12 adds the line.
   - **The partner-accept notice** (`pair-handler.ts:134`) is Task 11's, as the contract says. Task 12 doesn't touch it.
4. **`StartButtons` takes `browserHref?: string`, not `browser?: boolean`.** The component has no locale, since `startWords(t)` gets only a translator, and the link must be a plain anchor. smoke-zmanim-pages Z10 forbids a Next `<Link>` on the zmanim pages, because a prefetch counts against the city pages' per-address limit. So each of the four places passes `browserHref={signInHref(locale)}`, the one `/signin` builder (`src/site/signin.ts`). Two more changes follow from that: `StartAgain` gains a `browserHref` prop, and `FamCalBlock` gains a `locale` prop, which the city page already has.
5. **No new smoke file for the website.** The pins are in the five smokes the contract names, plus a Z16 in `smoke-zmanim-pages` (the FamCal block had no render check), plus a "browser does what the bots do" entry in `UNTRUE` (`scripts/lib/site-harness.ts`, read by `smoke-site-truth` T1 and by every page smoke).
6. **The Turnstile startup warning, its README rows and its `.env.example` lines are Task 3's** (part B, Step 12). `smoke-signin-setup` checks all four together. Task 14 writes only the README's "Web sign-up" section and the two places in the README that still say the web makes no accounts. It also adds an `S3` check to `smoke-signin-setup` for that section and for the two CLAUDE.md rules.
7. **`LEGAL_UPDATED` is the day of the fast-forward to main (ruling #28).** Task 14 writes the date of the day it runs (`TZ=Asia/Jerusalem date +%F`) for both documents, and the controller corrects both at the merge if the day has changed. `smoke-signin-legal` L3 asks for a day from 2026-11-04 up to today in Israel, so it passes either way.
8. **The "Short-lived copies" placement, as spec §7 says:** its two new items join the list under "The longest are:", after the 30-day note. That lead-in now reads oddly over two 10-minute items. The lawyer-review step (Task 14, Step 7) is asked about it. Moving them changes no block position (the list is one item of `keep.blocks[17]`).
9. **Ruling #19 (Task 14, Part 3 and the README):** people whose Google Calendar was connected before 6b have no `googleAccountKey`, so "Continue with Google" offers them sign-up (with the second-account warning) until they press "Turn on" in Settings. The owner asks those families to press "Turn on" once before sign-up is announced. Written in the setup section (ts10) and in the README's "Web sign-up" section.

```ts
// Smoke test for the admin's copy of a person's feedback (web sign-up plan, Task 12; spec 2026-11-03-web-sign-up §2.15):
// notifyAdminFeedback (src/utils/error-notifier.ts) names the sender by their FamCal id, and by their Telegram id too
// when they have one. An account made on famcal.bot has no Telegram, and its feedback reached the admin as "ID: N/A".
//
//  - A1 from an account with no Telegram: "FamCal id: 42", no Telegram line, no "N/A"; the name is escaped.
//  - A2 from a Telegram account: "FamCal id: 7" and "Telegram id: 1007"; a payment question's facts follow the sender.
//  - A3 both callers (the web app's /api/feedback and the bot's /feedback and /paysupport) hand it the person, not a
//    bare Telegram id.
//
// Real: error-notifier.ts and the escaping; the bot and Prisma are fakes that record. No network, no DB.
//
// Run with the fake env (never the real one), from the repo root:
//   $RUN smoke-feedback-admin   ($RUN is the header's single-smoke runner)

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

type Row = Record<string, any>; // eslint-disable-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');

type Result = { name: string; ok: boolean; reason?: string };
const results: Result[] = [];
async function check(name: string, fn: () => void | Promise<void>) {
  try {
    await fn();
    results.push({ name, ok: true });
  } catch (err) {
    results.push({ name, ok: false, reason: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
  }
}
function assert(cond: unknown, message: string): asserts cond {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(message);
}
const show = (v: unknown) => JSON.stringify(v, (_k, x) => (typeof x === 'bigint' ? `${x}n` : x));

globalThis.fetch = (async (input: unknown) => {
  throw new Error(`network is blocked in this smoke test: ${String(input)}`);
}) as typeof fetch;

const sent: { chatId: number; text: string }[] = [];
const fakeBot = { sendMessage: async (chatId: number, text: string) => { sent.push({ chatId, text }); return {}; } };
const fakePrisma = { user: { findMany: async () => [{ telegramId: BigInt(900) }] } };

async function main() {
  const Module = (await import('module')).default as unknown as {
    new (id: string): { filename: string; loaded: boolean; exports: unknown };
    _cache: Record<string, unknown>;
  };
  const stub = (file: string, exports: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    const filename = path.join(ROOT, file);
    const mod = new Module(filename);
    Object.assign(mod, { filename, loaded: true, exports });
    Module._cache[filename] = mod;
  };
  stub('src/utils/prisma.ts', { prisma: fakePrisma });
  stub('src/services/telegram/index.ts', { getBot: () => fakeBot });

  const { notifyAdminFeedback } = (await import(path.join(ROOT, 'src/utils/error-notifier.ts'))) as Row;

  await check('A1 feedback from an account with no Telegram names its FamCal id, has no Telegram line and no "N/A", and the name is escaped', async () => {
    sent.length = 0;
    await notifyAdminFeedback({ id: 42, name: 'Dana <web>', telegramId: null }, 'The week view is lovely', 'dashboard');
    assert(sent.length === 1 && sent[0].chatId === 900, `sent ${show(sent)}`);
    const text = sent[0].text;
    assert(text.includes('From: Dana &lt;web&gt;\n') && text.includes('\nFamCal id: 42\n'), text);
    assert(!text.includes('Telegram id') && !text.includes('N/A') && !/\nID: /.test(text), text);
    assert(text.includes('Source: dashboard') && text.endsWith('The week view is lovely'), text);
  });

  await check('A2 feedback from a Telegram account names the FamCal id and the Telegram id; a payment question\'s facts follow the sender', async () => {
    sent.length = 0;
    await notifyAdminFeedback({ id: 7, name: 'Noa', telegramId: 1007 }, 'Refund please', 'paysupport', { Plan: 'PRO' });
    const text = sent[0]?.text ?? '';
    assert(text.startsWith('💳 <b>Payment question</b>\nFrom: Noa\nFamCal id: 7\nTelegram id: 1007\nSource: paysupport\nPlan: PRO\n'), text);
  });

  await check('A3 both callers hand notifyAdminFeedback the person (their id, name and Telegram id), not a bare Telegram id', () => {
    const route = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/api/feedback/route.ts'), 'utf8');
    const bot = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'src/services/telegram/commands.ts'), 'utf8');
    assert(/notifyAdminFeedback\(user, trimmedText, 'dashboard'\)/.test(route), 'the web route still passes the name and the Telegram id');
    assert(/notifyAdminFeedback\(user, trimmedText, source,/.test(bot), 'the bot still passes the name and the Telegram id');
  });

  let failed = 0;
  for (const r of results) {
    console.log(`${r.ok ? 'OK' : 'FAIL'}  ${r.name}${r.ok ? '' : ` — ${r.reason}`}`);
    if (!r.ok) failed++;
  }
  console.log(`\n${results.length - failed}/${results.length} passed`);
  process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

#### Part 1: the Privacy Policy and the Terms

What spec §7 changes, and where:

| Spec §7 | Where |
|---|---|
| Who we are: the browser-only account | `privacy.who.blocks[0]` |
| What you have to give us | `privacy.required.blocks[0]` |
| Your account: the name; the two sign-in items; the `after` | `privacy.keep.blocks[1]` |
| Short-lived copies: two items | `privacy.keep.blocks[17]`, the "The longest are:" list (contract note 8) |
| Server logs: new accounts counted | `privacy.keep.blocks[19][1]` |
| Children | `privacy.children.blocks[1]` |
| Google user data, Signing in | `privacy.google.blocks[1][2]` |
| Cloudflare, Resend, the browser sentence | `privacy.processors.blocks[1][9]`, `[1][10]`, `[1][13]` |
| Where your data goes: the exception, and the Addendum sentence | `privacy.processors.blocks[3][1]`, new `[3][2]` |
| The people who run FamCal | `privacy.processors.blocks[5][2]` |
| Legal grounds: Turnstile | `privacy.euUk.blocks[2][2]` |
| Cookies | `privacy.cookies.blocks[0][1]` |
| Your rights: the confirmation, the only way, the ban | `privacy.rights.blocks[2]`, `[5][3]`, `[9][5]` |
| What FamCal is: the browser account | `terms.service`, a new paragraph after the last list |
| Who can use FamCal | `terms.eligibility.blocks[0]` |
| Your account and your family: the sentence, and the new one | `terms.account.blocks[0][1]`, new `[0][2]` |
| Paying | `terms.plans.blocks[5][0]` (not pinned by `smoke-terms-plans`) |
| Suspension, two sentences | `terms.suspension.blocks[0]`, `[2]` |

Each language says the same thing in its own register:
- **Hebrew:** gender-neutral, plural "you" (אתם/שלכם) as the file has it, «שמלאו לכם 18» (not «בני 18»), and companies in the feminine (Cloudflare משתמשת, Resend שומרת).
- **Russian:** formal «вы», with a U+00A0 after every one-letter word and before every dash (`smoke-site-truth` T6).

No plan number, refund window, section order or `cancel` id changes.
